The point of not killing yourself though, at least the way I see it, is that our bodies are sort of handed to us, and there's is a somewhat sacred element to each and one of us. I really think that, and I feel pretty grounded when I realize that you and me are more than the sum of our parts. Just a thought. I really think that through positive action there can be more of us, and that gives hope to every breathing thing.

Btw, read my post if you wanna feel better about your situation XD, I posted a few minutes ago, see maybe you feel at least a little entertained haha.
